{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Over the past year, a culture of extreme corruption in UAW leadership has come to a head in the news.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"UAW leaders have allegedly stolen millions from member dues for lavish personal vacations.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"UAW leaders have allegedly taken bribes directly from the Big Three auto companies.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"UAW now faces the threat of a government takeover by hostile anti-union forces in the Trump administration.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Right has taken advantage of the UAW crisis by telling workers they should stop paying their dues and abandon the union.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"As socialists, abandoning the union empowers bosses.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A grassroots movement to democratize the UAW has developed to take control of the UAW and restore workers’ faith in the union.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Members of Unite All Workers for Democracy (UAWD) are working to invoke Article 8 of the UAW’s constitution.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"If successful, UAWD will call a special convention and change the constitution so that members have a direct say in who leads the UAW at a national level.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Teamsters, Steelworkers, and Machinists already allow members a direct say in who leads at a national level.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
